about.title: A company with track record
about.lead: Over 20 years delivering solutions with a technical approach, operational reliability and continuous support.
about.subtitle: We bring efficiency to every project
about.text_after_gea: based in Mendoza, Argentina, specialising in technical and industrial solutions for the wine sector and industry in general. We work alongside wineries and wine-industry companies, and we also support projects across other industries with comprehensive technical solutions that boost productivity.

services.title: Industrial services for wineries
services.lead: We deliver machinery and metalwork solutions with a focus on quality, efficiency and after-sales support.
services.c1_text: We supply specialised equipment for the wine industry, including centrifuges, decanters and pumps, available for purchase or rental. We adapt to each winery's needs with flexible solutions that optimise your production processes.
services.c1_i1: Separator centrifuges for must and wine clarification
services.c1_i2: Decanters for wine and olive oil
services.c1_i3: Pumps for wineries and industrial processes
services.c1_i4: Rental per harvest or per project
services.c2_text: We stay with our clients well beyond the purchase, providing technical assistance, spare parts and maintenance. Our commitment is to keep your equipment running efficiently and continuously through the whole harvest and all year round, backed by a highly trained technical team.
services.c2_i1: Genuine GEA spare parts in stock for centrifuges and decanters
services.c2_i3: Commissioning and technical assistance during the harvest
services.c2_i4: Serving wineries and industries in Mendoza
services.c3_text: Design and fabrication of structures, walkways and stainless steel piping, heat fusion and PVC chilled-water piping. Custom installations focused on durability, functionality and efficiency for every stage of the production process.

decanter.video_label: Play video: GEA Multi-Purpose Wine Decanter
decanter.video_alt: GEA wine decanter, frame from the GEA Group video
decanter.label: GEA decanters and centrifuges
decanter.title: The GEA decanter: from must to wine in a single machine
decanter.text: The decanter is the most versatile machine in the winery: it clarifies must, recovers wine from lees and sediment, and handles free-run must, press must and olive oil. As official GEA distributors we sell it, rent it for the harvest and commission it at your winery, with our own spare parts and after-sales service.

metal.photo_alt: Grupo Tecnolog welder fabricating a custom metal walkway in the workshop
metal.label: In-house metal workshop
metal.title: Custom stainless steel solutions for wineries and industry
metal.text: We design and fabricate in stainless steel whatever each stage of the process needs: sanitary piping for wine transfer, heating and cooling heat exchangers, walkways and structures. We also do heat fusion and PVC chilled-water piping, with installations built to last and to perform at the peak of the harvest.
